title: Adding a New Module
text: dittoViz functions: use dittoViz_<PlotName> (e.g., dittoViz_scatterPlot dittoViz::scatterPlot) plotthis functions: use plotthis_<PlotName> (e.g., plotthis_AreaPlot plotthis::AreaPlot) custom/standalone functions: use plot name directly (e.g., linePlot, piePlot) adding brand-new plotting function (e.g., piePlot), define document plot function first, wrap module. Create three core files: R/<moduleName>_module_ui.R, R/<moduleName>_module_server.R, R/<moduleName>_module_app.R. Document UI, server, app functions roxygen (@export, params, examples). @section Plot parameters implemented altered functionality: - List inputs exposed @section Plot parameters defaults: - Document exposed parameters UI labels defaults @section Plot parameters implementing new functionality: - Document new plotly-specific controls (axes, ticks, reference lines, etc) Add example app uses module twice prove multi-instance behavior. Wire reactive defaults support parent apps can drive parameters app state (see Supporting Reactive Defaults). Freeze input update server plot render twice (see Updating Inputs Server). Debounce free-text input plot reads, textInput() rebuild plot per keystroke (see Debouncing Free-Text Inputs). Wire manual layout-edit persistence user-dragged titles, legends, annotations, colorbars survive re-renders (see Persisting Manual Layout Edits). Cover base plotting function testthat; cover module/app testServer feasible. Note ggplotly conversion quirks change drop functionality. Never use eval(str2expression()) raw user input. Use safe_eval_filter(), validate_expression(), safe_resolve_adj_fxn() instead (see Sanitizing User-Provided Expressions ). write CSS, anchor every selector class package owns — stylesheet goes host app’s document unscoped (see Styling CSS Containment).

code: minimalModuleServer <- function(id, data_reactive) {     # Step 1: Process data inside a moduleServer block     # This gives us access to inputs namespaced to 'id' (our module's inputs)     filtered_data <- moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {         reactive({             req(data_reactive())             df <- data_reactive()              # Input specific to this custom module             if (isTRUE(input$filter_setosa)) {                 if ("Species" %in% names(df)) {                     df <- df[df$Species == "setosa", ]                 }             }             df         })     })      # Step 2: Call the base module server OUTSIDE the moduleServer block     # This is critical! If we called this inside the moduleServer above,     # dittoViz_scatterPlotServer would look for inputs at id-id-inputName instead of id-inputName     dittoViz_scatterPlotServer(id, filtered_data) }

A unique event source + the edit store, created once.         plot_source <- session$ns("customplot")         edit_store <- setup_manual_edits(input, session, plot_source)          output$plot <- renderPlotly({             # 2. Create your plotly object with your plotting function             fig <- build_my_plotly_figure(data_reactive(), input)             # 3. Restore + capture edits on every render. Last: when only the             #    layout changed, it sends just that and ends the render.             finalize_manual_edits(fig, plot_source, edit_store, session)         })     }) }

what: Drawing a Custom Plot Once, Styling It Often
title: Building Custom Modules
text: Wrapping base module gets free. plot draw rebuilt whenever anything reads changes, titles, fonts, gridlines read alongside data, changing font redraws plot. Split two, base modules : cached_structure() draws plot caches , apply_uniform_styling() styles cached figure. traces stay across styling change, finalize_manual_edits() sends browser new layout. cache good can see, draw function three rules. Breaking one fail; draws stale plot: Read every input isolate_fn(input$key). wrapped read isolate_fn(.numeric(input$size)), bare input$size, never reaches cache key. Convert outside call. Name every reactive reads extra: colour stores, debounced text input, reactive argument. reactive derives data already covered. side effects. cache hit skips function, must show notifications write reactiveVal()s. Return anything else need list.
code: customPlotServer <- function(id, data_reactive, defaults = NULL) {     moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {         params <- setup_reactive_defaults(defaults, input, session)         plot_source <- session$ns("customplot")         edit_store <- setup_manual_edits(input, session, plot_source)          # What is drawn: cached, keyed on the data and every input read here.         draw_plot <- function(isolate_fn) {             p <- my_plot_function(data_reactive(), x = isolate_fn(input$x.by))             list(fig = plotly::ggplotly(p))         }         base_plot <- cached_structure(draw_plot, input, session, data_reactive, params = params)          # How it looks: re-run for a styling change, without redrawing.         generate_plot <- reactive({             isolate_fn <- setup_auto_update_logic(input, params)             apply_uniform_styling(base_plot()$fig, input, isolate_fn)         })          output$plot <- renderPlotly({             finalize_manual_edits(apply_render_margins(generate_plot(), input), plot_source, edit_store, session)         })     }) }

what: Helpers for Modules in Extension Packages
title: Building Custom Modules
text: module built VizModules’ exports (package, say) can reuse helpers built-modules share, rather keeping copies: UI side, uniform_subplot_spacing_inputs_ui(ns, defaults) adds subplot spacing controls Facet tab (reset_plotly_inputs() already resets , apply_facet_subplot_spacing() applies ), uniform_stats_inputs_ui(ns, defaults) adds Stats tab (reset_stats_inputs() resets ). Seed multiColorPicker() built inside renderUI() default_group_colors(defaults, "palette.colours"). See “Adding New Module” vignette full list.
code: extendedServer <- function(id, data, defaults = NULL, hide.inputs = NULL) {     moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {         data <- require_data_frame(data)          # A faceted plot has no editable main title: swap in the facet title inputs.         observe({             toggle_facet_title_inputs(session, nz_value(input$facet.by), hidden = hide.inputs)         })          output$plot <- renderPlotly({             # "" (nothing chosen), NA and NULL all become NULL.             facet.by <- blank_to_null(input$facet.by)             # Jitter stays put across rebuilds instead of redrawing on every input change.             with_stable_seed(build_my_plotly_figure(data(), facet.by = facet.by))         })          observeEvent(input$reset, {             # Restore the group colour picker to the mapping in `defaults`.             reset_group_colors(session, "palette.colours", defaults, groups(), default_palette_values)             reset_plotly_inputs(session, defaults)         })     }) }

code: library(VizModules)  # The same defaults go to the controls and the server, so Reset returns to them. cars_defaults <- list(x.by = "wt", y.by = "mpg", color.by = "cyl")  ui <- fluidPage(     sidebarLayout(         sidebarPanel(             dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI("cars", mtcars, defaults = cars_defaults)         ),         mainPanel(dittoViz_scatterPlotOutputUI("cars"))     ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {     dittoViz_scatterPlotServer("cars", data = reactive(mtcars), defaults = cars_defaults) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Quick Start with VizModules
text: Defaults: Pass named list defaults argument *InputsUI() pre-fill inputs, list module’s *Server() Reset button returns . Names module’s input IDs, mostly match underlying plot function’s arguments (e.g., defaults = list(color.= "cyl", size = 3) scatter plot). Reactive defaults: entry may reactive() instead fixed value, input follows app’s state (e.g. defaults = list(color.= reactive(input$colour_col))). See vignette("defaults--hiding", package = "VizModules"). Hide inputs: Use hide.inputs server call remove controls still initializing values. useful app sets certain parameters wants hide control various elements still passing initial values. Hide tabs: Use hide.tabs remove whole groups controls (e.g., "Plotly" "Legend" scatterPlot). Hidden inputs tabs still feed values plot, module stays fully configured exposing users need.
code: server <- function(input, output, session) {     dittoViz_scatterPlotServer(         "cars",         data = reactive(mtcars),         hide.inputs = c("split.by", "shape.by"),         hide.tabs = c("Plotly")     ) }

code: if (interactive()) {     library(shiny)     library(plotly)      ui <- fluidPage(         plotlyOutput("plot"),         downloadButton("download_summary", "Download Summary")     )      server <- function(input, output, session) {         # A reactive plotly plot         plot_reactive <- reactive({             plot_ly(mtcars, x = ~wt, y = ~mpg, type = "scatter", mode = "markers")         })          # Optional: a reactive returning a stats data.frame         stats_reactive <- reactive({             data.frame(                 metric = c("mean_mpg", "sd_mpg"),                 value  = c(mean(mtcars$mpg), sd(mtcars$mpg))             )         })          # Optional: capture all UI inputs as a named list         AllInputs <- reactive({             reactiveValuesToList(input)         })          output$plot <- renderPlotly(plot_reactive())          # Assemble the summary, then wire up the download handler.         plot_summary_reactive <- reactive({             collect_source_data(                 plot_reactive   = plot_reactive,                 stats_reactive  = stats_reactive,                 inputs_reactive = AllInputs()             )         })          output$download_summary <- create_source_download_handler(             data_list     = plot_summary_reactive,             filename_base = "my_plot_summary"         )     }      shinyApp(ui, server) }

what: Using the stat helpers in a custom module
title: Statistical Testing
text: pipeline fully exported: compute_pairwise_stats() — run tests, return data frame. create_stat_annotations() — convert results plotly shapes annotations. apply_stat_annotations() — append plotly figure. Axis coordinates. create_stat_annotations() positions brackets using 1-based categorical x-coordinates, matching figures built ggplotly() (every VizModules plot module ). build figure raw plot_ly(type = "box") call instead, plotly uses 0-based category positions brackets appear shifted one category right — prefer ggplotly() ggplot object stay consistent modules.
code: library(VizModules) library(ggplot2) library(plotly)  stats_df <- compute_pairwise_stats(     df   = example_iris,     x    = "Species",     y    = "Sepal.Length",     test = "wilcox.test",     p.adjust.method = "holm" )  # Build the figure with ggplot2 + ggplotly(), matching how the plot modules # construct their figures. This matters for bracket placement: ggplotly() # categorical axes are 1-based (the first factor level sits at x = 1), which # is the convention create_stat_annotations() expects. p <- ggplot(example_iris, aes(x = Species, y = Sepal.Length)) +     geom_boxplot() fig <- ggplotly(p)  stat_result <- create_stat_annotations(     stats_df = stats_df,     fig      = fig,     df       = example_iris,     x        = "Species",     y        = "Sepal.Length",     display  = "symbol" )  apply_stat_annotations(fig, stat_result)

title: Flexible, Interactive shiny Modules for Almost Any Plot
text: dittoViz_scatterPlot - x/y coordinate plots additional color, shape, size encodings (wraps dittoViz::scatterPlot). Supports density, histogram, rug marginal distributions along axis, trajectories groups’ medians, size legend scale set, overlaying fit lines, including multiple custom model lines defined interactively: add row per model, R model formula (e.g. revenue ~ poly(units, 2)), fitting function (lm, glm, loess, registered backend), line colour, width, see vignette("custom-model-lines", package = "VizModules"). dittoViz_yPlot - Multi-variate Y-axis plots (boxplot, jitter, violinplots - wraps dittoViz::yPlot). dittoViz_freqPlot - Box/jitter plots discrete observation frequencies per sample/group (wraps dittoViz::freqPlot).

title: Flexible, Interactive shiny Modules for Almost Any Plot
text: plotthis_AreaPlot - Stacked area charts (wraps plotthis::AreaPlot). plotthis_BoxPlot - Box plots (wraps plotthis::BoxPlot). plotthis_BarPlot - Bar charts (wraps plotthis::BarPlot). plotthis_SplitBarPlot - Split bar charts (wraps plotthis::SplitBarPlot). plotthis_DensityPlot - Density plots (wraps plotthis::DensityPlot). plotthis_DotPlot - Dot plots (wraps plotthis::DotPlot), size legend scale set. plotthis_Histogram - Histograms (wraps plotthis::Histogram).

text: following radarPlot() parameters exposed UI inputs: palette - Color palette name; use colors via color picker UI instead legend.x - Legend horizontal position offset (use defaults set) legend.y - Legend vertical position offset (use defaults set) title.text - Plot title text (plotly allows interactive editing; use defaults set)

title: Input UI components for the radarPlot module — radarPlotInputsUI
text: following radarPlot() parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: theta - Category column angular axes (UI: "Category column (theta)", default: 1st categorical column) r - Values column radial distance (UI: "Values column (r)", default: 1st numeric column) group - Optional grouping column multiple traces (UI: "Group column", default: NULL) fill - Fill area trace (UI: "Fill area", default: "toself") line.width - Line width (UI: "Line width", default: 2) line.dash - Line dash style (UI: "Line style", default: "solid") marker.size - Marker size (UI: "Marker size", default: 5) marker.symbol - Marker symbol (UI: "Marker symbol", default: "circle") opacity - Trace opacity (UI: "Opacity", default: 0.6) colors - Trace colors (UI: color picker, derived palette) radial.visible - Show radial axis (UI: "Show radial axis", default: TRUE) radial.range - Radial axis range (UI: "Radial min" "Radial max", default: auto) radial.showline - Show radial axis line (UI: "Show radial line", default: TRUE) radial.linecolor - Radial axis line color (UI: "Radial line color", default: "#444444") radial.gridcolor - Radial grid color (UI: "Radial grid color", default: "#EEEEEE") angular.direction - Angular axis direction (UI: "Angular direction", default: "clockwise") angular.rotation - Angular axis rotation (UI: "Angular rotation", default: 90) angular.gridcolor - Angular grid color (UI: "Angular grid color", default: "#EEEEEE") title.x - Title horizontal position (UI: "Title horizontal position", default: 0.5) title.font.size - Plot title font size (UI: "Title Size", default: 26) title.font.family - Font family title text (UI: "Title Font", default: "Arial") title.font.color - Color plot title (UI: "Title Color", default: "#000000") show.legend - Show legend (UI: "Show legend", default: TRUE) legend.orientation - Legend orientation (UI: "Legend orientation", default: "h") legend.font.family - Legend font (UI: "Legend font", default: "Arial") legend.font.size - Legend font size (UI: "Legend font size", default: 12) legend.font.color - Legend font color (UI: "Legend font color", default: "#000000") bgcolor - Plot background color (UI: "Plot background color", default: "#FFFFFF") polar.bgcolor - Polar area background color (UI: "Polar area background", default: "#FFFFFF") trace.colors - Named character vector mapping group levels colors, e.g. c(= "#FF0000", B = "blue") (UI: "Trace colors"). Seeds picker; unnamed groups fall back default palette user edits take precedence. single.color - Trace color used grouping set (UI: "Trace color:", default: "#1F77B4")
